description: This file defines a 'callout' node for a rich text editor, including its attributes, rendering, input rules, commands, and node view. It is part of the Notesnook project and manages callout blocks like notes, warnings, tips, etc.

classes.name: Callout
classes.description: A ProseMirror node representing a callout block with attributes for type and collapsed state, including methods for parsing, rendering, commands, input rules, and node view.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Defines attributes for the callout node, including type and collapsed state, with HTML parsing and rendering logic.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Specifies the HTML tag ('div.callout') that represents the callout node.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Returns the HTML representation of the callout node as a div with class 'callout'.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides the 'setCallout' command to create a callout block with specified attributes, inserting it into the document.

methods.name: addInputRules
methods.description: Defines input rules to automatically convert specific text patterns into callout nodes.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a custom DOM node view for the callout, handling interactions like collapsing/expanding and visibility.
